sources.title: 百年京张 AI 创新带投稿场地包与机器可读任务资料
sources.publisher: open-city-ai/haidian repository maintainers
sources.license_or_reuse: Repository materials used under their stated project and file-level terms.
allowed_use: Submission structure, task interpretation, enums, schemas, planning ranges, standards snapshots, and validation requirements.
Working evidence package for reproducible proposal preparation.
prohibited_use: Promoting provisional geometry, missing controls, or scaffold defaults into official planning facts.
Treating machine validation as planning approval, product certification, or engineering acceptance.
transformations: Mapped the task package into proposal chapters, matrices, geometry, metrics, drawings, and offline visual artifacts.
limitations: The site package remains a living repository resource and must be re-read when upstream changes.
Official overall and key-area polygons remain unavailable on the access date.

sources.title: 百年京张 AI 创新带公开资料登记表
sources.publisher: open-city-ai/haidian repository maintainers
sources.license_or_reuse: Repository metadata used to preserve the stated evidence and reuse boundaries of registered sources.
allowed_use: Distinguishing formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and prohibited uses.
Auditing the evidence status of repository-provided inputs.
prohibited_use: Upgrading background or provisional material into official controls.
Inferring that an unregistered external source has received central approval.
transformations: Applied registry use classes to proposal claims, assumptions, and source limitations.
limitations: The registry governs repository sources; participant-collected sources still require complete package-level records and independent review.

sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public announcement; quoted facts are paraphrased and linked.
allowed_use: Project name, organizers, three scope descriptions, announced areas, design tasks, and deliverable context.
Formal task and scope evidence when read with the local official snapshot.
prohibited_use: Precise polygon, road redline, statutory control, ownership, engineering feasibility, or implementation commitment.
transformations: Extracted task clauses and area values into the proposal and matrices.
limitations: Textual boundaries and announced areas do not replace an official GIS or CAD polygon.

sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带三层范围与三处重点区临时粗略 polygon
sources.publisher: open-city-ai/haidian repository maintainers
sources.license_or_reuse: Repository-maintained provisional geometry for intake testing and visualization only.
allowed_use: Temporary generation boundary, conceptual visualization, intake self-check, and design discussion with explicit provisional labels.
prohibited_use: Official redline, statutory planning control, precise official area claim, ownership, approval, or implementation basis.
transformations: Copied without moving the SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA coordinates.
Recomputed submitted areas in EPSG:4548 and propagated low confidence.
limitations: Derived from public textual clues and approximate areas; exact official polygons remain unavailable.
PROV-KEY-003 is an ordered area placeholder and is not independently anchored to Dazhongsi Station.

sources.title: PROV-KEY-003 大钟寺占位范围的站点锚定疑问
sources.publisher: open-city-ai/haidian contributors and maintainers
sources.license_or_reuse: Public GitHub discussion; facts are limited to reproducible geometry checks and maintainer guidance.
allowed_use: Evidence that the three provisional key-area rectangles are ordered and area-fitted placeholders, not station/road-anchored official polygons.
Process guidance to preserve the central provisional geometry and wait for a versioned official replacement.
prohibited_use: Using community distance checks to create an official boundary, or independently moving the central geometry.
transformations: Recorded the unresolved anchor as an assumption and whole-package recalculation trigger.
limitations: The issue remains open because official key-area polygons and anchor relationships are unavailable.

sources.title: 临时总体设计范围与已测绘京张铁路遗址公园 polygon 的偏差审计
sources.publisher: open-city-ai/haidian contributors and maintainers
sources.license_or_reuse: Public GitHub discussion; OSM-derived readings remain background-only.
allowed_use: Evidence that the repository provisional boundary and an OSM-mapped park polygon differ, with both datasets explicitly limited.
Process guidance to keep the provisional boundary unchanged until official geometry is supplied.
prohibited_use: Promoting OSM, Overpass, or community-derived geometry into an official boundary or formal scoring basis.
transformations: Recorded the discrepancy as a disclosure and whole-package recalculation trigger without importing OSM geometry.
limitations: The mapped park may cover only built portions; the provisional boundary is also inferred. Official polygons must resolve the relationship.

sources.title: 面向全球智能体开展百年京张AI创新带城市设计开源征集任务书摘录
sources.publisher: User-provided cleared taskbook
sources.license_or_reuse: Cleared structured excerpt retained in the repository.
allowed_use: Agent co-creation principles, six tasks, scenario and branding requirements, operations, and boundary clauses.
prohibited_use: Official redline, statutory planning control, engineering feasibility, or government commitment.
transformations: Mapped every required task to report, geometry, metrics, drawings, and visual sections.
limitations: The original Word file is not archived; the repository excerpt is the working reference.

sources.title: “三区两翼”打造世界级AI集聚地
sources.publisher: 北京市科学技术委员会、中关村科技园区管理委员会
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public information page; paraphrase only.
allowed_use: Three Zones and Two Wings narrative and regional innovation context.
prohibited_use: Parcel, firm, investment, output, or committed policy claims not stated by the source.
transformations: Converted the regional narrative into a proposed repair-service value chain.
limitations: Background context does not establish project-specific delivery commitments.

sources.title: 海淀区发布“1+X+1”现代化产业体系建设布局
sources.publisher: 北京市海淀区人民政府
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public information page; paraphrase only.
allowed_use: AI and technology-service industrial positioning and scenario-opening context.
prohibited_use: Guaranteed project investment, tenant list, fiscal support, or site allocation.
transformations: Used as strategic background for enterprise services and circular procurement.
limitations: District-level direction does not prove implementation at a particular parcel.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2024/1799 on common rules promoting the repair of goods
sources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
sources.license_or_reuse: Official Journal legal text; factual paraphrase and citation only.
allowed_use: Institutional reference for repair obligations, repair information, and service-platform design.
prohibited_use: Claiming the directive applies in China, covers all goods, or directly governs urban AI equipment.
transformations: Abstracted service transparency and repair-information principles.
limitations: Member-state transposition/application deadline is 2026-07-31.
Scope is product-specific and not universal.

sources.title: Indice de réparabilité
sources.publisher: Ministère de la Transition écologique, France
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public information; no official graphic copied.
allowed_use: Reference for a transparent 0-10 repairability information method and score components.
prohibited_use: Treating the French score as a Chinese statutory grade or copying the official visual identity.
transformations: Translated score dimensions into a proposed urban-AI asset maintainability grade.
limitations: Applies to specified French product categories, not the proposed equipment fleet by default.

sources.title: Indice de durabilité
sources.publisher: Ministère de la Transition écologique, France
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public information; no official graphic copied.
allowed_use: Reference for combining repairability and reliability with disclosed scoring detail.
prohibited_use: Claiming universal product coverage or importing the index as local regulation.
transformations: Abstracted durability disclosure into service-life and redeployment records.
limitations: Initial implementation in 2025 concerns televisions and washing machines only.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 establishing a framework for ecodesign requirements for sustainable products
sources.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
sources.license_or_reuse: Official Journal legal text; factual paraphrase and citation only.
allowed_use: Architecture reference for product-passport fields, access roles, and traceability.
prohibited_use: Claiming every product already carries a mandatory passport or that EU law applies locally.
transformations: Abstracted a non-statutory equipment-passport data model.
limitations: Product-specific obligations depend on subsequent delegated acts.

sources.title: The Global E-waste Monitor 2024
sources.publisher: International Telecommunication Union and UNITAR
sources.license_or_reuse: Public report; numbers are attributed and no charts are reproduced.
allowed_use: Global context: 62 Mt generated in 2022, 22.3% formally collected and recycled, and 82 Mt projected for 2030.
prohibited_use: Using global figures as a Beijing baseline, local target, or measured project outcome.
transformations: Used only to explain the scale of the global materials problem.
limitations: Global aggregates do not describe Haidian or the proposal site.

sources.title: Circular Transition Indicators v4.0
sources.publisher: World Business Council for Sustainable Development
sources.license_or_reuse: CC BY-ND 4.0 for CTI versions 1-4; paraphrase only and do not adapt official graphics.
allowed_use: Method reference for material circularity definitions and organization-level measurement logic.
prohibited_use: Redrawing or modifying protected CTI graphics, or treating CTI as a statutory city indicator.
transformations: Created independent project KPI definitions without copying source diagrams.
limitations: Voluntary corporate self-assessment framework, not a municipal planning standard.

sources.title: Remanufacturing process
sources.publisher: Caterpillar Inc.
sources.license_or_reuse: Corporate public page; paraphrase only, with no trademark or imagery reused.
allowed_use: Process-chain reference: core return, disassembly, cleaning, inspection, restoration, reassembly, and testing.
prohibited_use: Generalizing company claims about quality, cost, carbon, or warranty to the proposal.
transformations: Abstracted a generic remanufacturing workflow and independent labels.
limitations: Corporate self-description; automated access returned HTTP 403 in the audit environment.

sources.title: VDA 5050 - Interface for the communication between automated guided vehicles and a master control
sources.publisher: German Association of the Automotive Industry (VDA)
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public specification page and release metadata; paraphrase only.
allowed_use: Interoperability precedent for fleet-control interfaces and replaceable suppliers.
prohibited_use: Treating VDA 5050 as a repair, spare-parts, certification, or safety standard.
transformations: Used only to support the need for cross-vendor interface contracts.
limitations: Version 3.0.0 was released in March 2026; applicability requires technical verification.

sources.title: RepairMonitor factsheet provides insight into repair data for 2024
sources.publisher: Repair Café International Foundation
sources.license_or_reuse: Public nonprofit factsheet; paraphrase only.
allowed_use: Reference for structured community-repair work orders and failure-mode learning.
prohibited_use: Using the reported 62% success rate as an industry benchmark or project target.
transformations: Abstracted fields for symptom, intervention, outcome, and learning feedback.
limitations: More than 37,000 voluntarily entered 2024 cases are not a representative market sample.

sources.title: 废弃电器电子产品回收处理管理条例
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国国务院 / 生态环境部公开页面
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public legal text; paraphrase only.
allowed_use: Defining the boundary between repair/refurbishment and regulated treatment of catalogued waste electrical products.
prohibited_use: Claiming all robots, sensors, or terminals are catalogued WEEE, or that every dismantling act always needs this qualification.
transformations: Converted the legal distinction into an on-site/off-site operating boundary.
limitations: Article 2 excludes product repair and refurbishment, and reuse as second-hand goods after repair/refurbishment, from the defined treatment activity.
Catalog scope and actual activity must be assessed case by case.

sources.title: 废弃电器电子产品处理资格许可管理办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国环境保护部 / 生态环境部公开页面
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public legal text; paraphrase only.
allowed_use: Qualification boundary for treatment of products in the national WEEE treatment catalogue.
prohibited_use: Extending the permit rule beyond the catalogue or beyond legally defined treatment activities.
transformations: Used to define transfer triggers to a scope-matched qualified facility.
limitations: Specific equipment and process classification requires professional legal and environmental review.

sources.title: 危险废物经营许可证管理办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国国务院 / 生态环境部公开页面
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public legal text; paraphrase only.
allowed_use: Boundary for collecting, storing, and treating components legally classified as hazardous waste.
prohibited_use: Pre-classifying every battery or electronic component as hazardous waste without identification.
transformations: Used to require isolation, records, and transfer when hazardous-waste classification or damage triggers apply.
limitations: Waste classification, transfer procedures, and license scope require operator-specific confirmation.

sources.title: 城市设计管理办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public regulation snapshot.
allowed_use: Urban-design structure, public space, character, and implementation linkage.
prohibited_use: Substituting conceptual design for approved statutory planning.
transformations: Mapped requirements to structure, public space, character, and depth evidence.
limitations: The proposal remains conceptual and awaits official controls.

sources.title: 城市、镇控制性详细规划编制审批办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public regulation snapshot.
allowed_use: Separating approved controls, conceptual design quantities, and pending official data.
prohibited_use: Claiming FAR, height, density, road redline, or parcel decision without approved conditions.
transformations: Set statutory metrics to unknown while retaining reproducible conceptual geometry metrics.
limitations: Does not supply project-specific controls.

sources.title: 国土空间调查、规划、用途管制用地用海分类指南
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国自然资源部
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public classification guide snapshot.
allowed_use: Land-use code selection and machine-readable classification.
prohibited_use: Treating the proposal partition as an approved land-use plan.
transformations: Applied repository-enumerated codes to nine conceptual land-use polygons.
limitations: Project-specific land-use approval is absent.

sources.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等七部门
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public legal text snapshot.
allowed_use: Governance background for public-facing generative AI services when the legal scope applies.
prohibited_use: Turning the measure into a generic right-to-exit rule or a project-specific filing conclusion.
transformations: Used as a boundary reference for human review, complaints, and content-service governance.
limitations: Applicability depends on the actual service and operator.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国无障碍环境建设法
sources.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public legal text snapshot.
allowed_use: Continuous physical accessibility and applicable public-service human-assistance design.
prohibited_use: Generalizing Article 39 to every public space or digital service.
transformations: Used for accessible paths, readable interfaces, and human service fallback.
limitations: Specific facility compliance requires detailed design and review.

sources.title: 关于切实解决老年人运用智能技术困难实施方案
sources.publisher: 国务院办公厅
sources.license_or_reuse: Official public policy snapshot.
allowed_use: Policy reference for retaining conventional service and human assistance alongside smart service.
prohibited_use: Claiming the 2020-2022 plan is a current 2026 project mandate or local implementation fact.
transformations: Used as an inclusion precedent for non-app and staffed service routes.
limitations: Time-limited national policy context, not a statutory site control.
